notes: Records reconcile the R00 dispatch producer/operation inventory characterized in TC-01-baseline.md with the six production adapter call sites and the library/manual lifecycle surfaces. Facet defaults live in feature_pipeline.domain.task_kinds._RECORD_DEFAULTS; a record only names what differs.

task_kinds.title: Prompt discovery and plan loading
task_kinds.summary: Deterministic reads of the explicit anchors, prompt, plan, and task files into validated inputs; never authors a plan with an LLM.

task_kinds.title: Requirements/codebase/design analysis and task planning
task_kinds.summary: Operator/planner workflow that turns intent, repository findings, and constraints into plan and task metadata with a dependency order. No production planner adapter exists.

task_kinds.title: Selection, compilation and adapter composition
task_kinds.summary: Turns the profile, task graph, explicit controls, and availability facts into a compiled plan, a selected scope, and one concrete adapter shared across the executor and verifier slots.

task_kinds.title: Executor implementation, including scoped test authoring, config, and docs tasks
task_kinds.summary: The LLM executor implements only the selected task's allowed scope, runs the declared verification commands, and reports the status envelope. Test authoring is folded into implementation, not a separate producer.

task_kinds.title: Executor status continuation
task_kinds.summary: Non-Codex compatibility path: a read-only, no-tools request in the same Claude session (or a runner-observed status for fresh-envelope adapters) that produces the strict executor JSON envelope.

task_kinds.title: Codex executor final-result parsing
task_kinds.summary: Deterministic runner parse of the raw JSONL terminal result matching role/task/attempt into a runner-created envelope, or a protocol-invalid diagnostic. Never fabricates a task block.

task_kinds.title: Task command pass
task_kinds.summary: Shell-free process execution of the task-declared ordered cwd/argv, producing command records, exit dispositions, and an explicit unrun remainder. No adapter or model.

task_kinds.title: Acceptance verifier report
task_kinds.summary: A fresh read-only task-verifier launch that judges the acceptance criteria against the actual implementation and command evidence and returns a prose report plus session id. Never sees the other verifier's output.

task_kinds.title: Test-evidence verifier report
task_kinds.summary: A fresh read-only, no-tools test-verifier launch that interprets the runner's command records to confirm the declared verification commands genuinely pass, returning a prose report plus session id.

task_kinds.title: Each verifier's verdict continuation
task_kinds.summary: A continuation of the original verifier role that emits the strict four-key verdict envelope. Claude resumes the session; Codex starts a fresh read-only exec. Countable separately from the report call.
task_kinds.notes: Applies to both the task-verifier and test-verifier roles.

task_kinds.title: Low-level independent-verifier helper
task_kinds.summary: A caller-supplied pair of read-only requests and evidence combined into a minimal VerificationOutcome. Library/test surface, separate from the production report-plus-envelope orchestrator.

task_kinds.title: Repair consolidation and redispatch
task_kinds.summary: The runner writes a numbered repair report from both failed verifier reports and the unchanged task contract, consumes one repair, and redispatches a fresh executor through the complete command and two-verifier gate. Same role and pinned adapter.

task_kinds.title: Run resume and dependency evidence reuse
task_kinds.summary: The runner resume path: compatible contracts, availability, and eligible source evidence yield a resumed lifecycle or a denial, plus an immutable reuse entry. Verified/reused dependencies launch no executor or verifier.

task_kinds.title: Board/result projection
task_kinds.summary: Durable task status plus command/verifier completion evidence projected onto the active Markdown board and the task-local Result, only within execution scope. Boardless plans omit projection. No model.

task_kinds.title: Documentation maintenance
task_kinds.summary: A supplied documenter callback that maps a DocumentationRequest to an implemented-status mapping with a report reference. Requires all selected tasks verified. No callback-to-adapter composition in production execute.

task_kinds.title: Independent documentation audit
task_kinds.summary: A supplied auditor callback that maps an AuditRequest, including the documentation report, to PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED. Rejects the identical documenter/auditor callable. No production adapter launch found.

task_kinds.title: Graphify refresh
task_kinds.summary: A runner wrapper around a declared integration wrapper/cwd/argv producing exit status, logs, output, and diff checks. The external tool's internal LLM/nested work is not registered or metered by the core.

task_kinds.title: Graphify validation and final checks
task_kinds.summary: Required graph outputs plus a tracked diff and final policy commands drive stage computations and captured results after final documentation. No verifier adapter call for graph output checks.

task_kinds.title: Final-diff gate and release preview
task_kinds.summary: A human decision plus the runner gate the release dry-run preview from an approved diff and policy/check facts. Stages 10-14 stay planned in the preview; an actual commit has no code path and push is denied.

task_kinds.title: Generic stage/extension callback
task_kinds.summary: A registered stage handler/context or ToolStage argv driven by PipelineEngine.run / run_tool_stage. A library extension surface; ToolStage.subagents is metadata, not an automatic adapter launch.
task_kinds.notes: New handlers can contain work outside the six direct adapter calls; the core registers no nested child-work ledger.

task_kinds.title: CLI process transport
task_kinds.summary: The adapter infrastructure that turns one LaunchRequest into a shell-free CLI argv/stdin/cwd/timeout and a LaunchResult with session/raw output. Carries no model, effort, or stack fields.

task_kinds.title: Manual and nested delegation
task_kinds.summary: An operator/skill workflow in which an executor's shell access invokes tools or CLIs, or a worker shell/native delegation runs child-session work outside the central inventory. Not proven isolated by an argv fixture.

task_kinds.title: Repository commit
task_kinds.summary: Reserved: no runner code path performs a commit and the mechanics stay disabled. The release preview keeps stages 10-16 planned only; there is no dispatchable commit kind.
task_kinds.notes: Reserved identity so a future authorized commit surface has a stable name; today it must never be routed or dispatched.

task_kinds.title: Repository push
task_kinds.summary: Unsupported: push is permanently denied at the adapter (Bash(git push:*) on every launch) and no task kind routes to it. Present only so the denial is an explicit, testable catalog fact.
task_kinds.notes: PUSH_DENY_TOOL = Bash(git push:*) reaches the CLI on every launch; there is no routable or dispatchable push kind.
